excluded_paper_components: Retain Table1 dt=.001,T=1,spread=.01,q=5,p=.2 and total diffusion variance=.03.
Separate parameter-extraction network omitted; actor/critics take normalized state directly.
Four random-behavior episodes and 128 updates replace 1000 training episodes and 200 test episodes.
Hidden layers8 replace256; hidden activation is tanh instead of the source ReLU. The Gaussian action also has a separate tanh squash. Fixed entropy coefficient .2 and gamma .99 are disclosed.
Modern twin-Q target follows the implemented stable-baselines-style SAC rather than the earlier separate-V equations.
Gaussian latent score is explicitly quantized into sell/hold/buy posting controls.
The critic learns the collected continuous latent, whose quantized posting control produced the reward; it does not treat an integer control as that latent.
Simulated diffusion approximation and independent order-flow draws do not reconstruct a calibrated non-Markov LOB.

Interval probability fill approximation may fill an off-touch resting quote; it does not enforce exchange price priority. No queue priority, partial fills, market impact or original experimental reward distribution claim.
